findings.summary: The frozen implementation and SHA-bound verification evidence show that recovery is limited to evaluator-supplied deterministic-evidence gaps, delegates only deterministic verification to TESTER, returns semantic ownership to EVALUATOR after refresh, rejects unrelated semantic blocks, handles artifact-only descendant commits, and preserves publication blockers.
findings.broken_invariant: No contract invariant is broken; the bounded recovery, semantic-ownership, negative-path, and publication-safety invariants are covered.
